title: Miss Kobayashi's Dragon Maid
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: After a drunken night in the mountains, programmer Kobayashi pulls a holy sword from a dragon named Tohru, who repays her by moving in as a human-form maid. Other dragons and mythical beings follow, including the exiled young dragon Kanna, whom Kobayashi comes to mother. The slice-of-life comedy grows into a found family, and Tohru and Kobayashi eventually become a couple.
life_message: It holds up a chosen family built from care, patience and everyday kindness across very different beings.
